title: Predicting EGFR mutation, ALK rearrangement, and uncommon EGFR mutation in NSCLC patients by driverless artificial intelligence: a cohort study
summary: A stacked deep/machine-learning ensemble predicts EGFR and ALK status against molecular reference in a consecutive test cohort; single-center design and reported test accuracy delimit generalization. Methods/Results: 1,089 retrospective training cases and 1,464 consecutive test cases; stacked ensemble of one DL and five ML models; test AUC .883 EGFR and .921 ALK, plus common/uncommon EGFR accuracy .83. Publisher article details and testing results checked.
